brief:
For the first time in three years, Gaza's children are returning to classrooms, the Palestine News Network reported. The resumption of classes marks an end to an extended educational disruption, though the back-to-school season bears little resemblance to conditions before the closure.

The return signals a partial restoration of normal life in Gaza, even as the educational landscape remains fundamentally altered from pre-closure years.
dek: GAZA CITY, Gaza Strip /PNN / For the first time in three years, Gaza’s children are returning to classrooms.But there are few signs of the back-to-school season they once knew.
title: Gaza's children return to school after three-year closure
